PG 1.text: Oi! What did he do? Stop the battle!
PG 1.speaker: Keaton Fort

PG 2.text: Who are you? You don't look like you are from here.
PG 2.speaker: Kon Fine

PG 2.text: Just listen to me. When you meet my daughter, Nono Himono, ask her where is your father.
PG 2.speaker: Masato Himono

PG 2.text: Who is Nono? Do you expect me to find her-
PG 2.speaker: Kon Fine

PG 2.text: Please. When the time is right...
PG 2.speaker: Masato Himono

PG 3.text: What the hell did he make me do?
PG 3.speaker: Kon Fine

PG 4.text: We're already on to the 3rd battle. She hasn't won one yet.
PG 4.speaker: Aero Nami

PG 4.text: That was one of the Zone Archons we planned to win against.
PG 4.speaker: Keaton Fort

PG 4.text: Now that she has proved that she does not know me... please let her go-
PG 4.speaker: Masato Himono

PG 4.text: You think the reason we are convicting her is because of her relationship to you?
PG 4.speaker: Sam Potter

PG 4.text: We will put her down because she is a monster!
PG 4.speaker: Sam Potter

PG 4.text: You have changed... Sam. Did the High Order change-
PG 4.speaker: Masato Himono

PG 5.text: You are the one locked up right now, Masato! You are the only one who changed!
PG 5.speaker: Sam Potter

PG 5.text: You didn't use to be this cold-hearted.
PG 5.speaker: Masato Himono

PG 5.text: When did you become so cold hearted... She's a Dozer but...
PG 5.speaker: Prev Chief (Sam's wife)

PG 5.text: The previous chief... she believed and cared for a Dozer for years. We took that Dozer in... fed it with care and never suspected it.
PG 5.speaker: Sam Potter

PG 5.text: But on that fateful night, she was consumed. That imagery never left...
PG 5.speaker: Sam Potter

PG 6.text: She is a Dozer. You don't even know a single thing about them!
PG 6.speaker: Sam Potter

PG 6.text: I am not like the rest of you. When I see a Dozer, I am exterminating it.
PG 6.speaker: Sam Potter

PG 6.text: This is bad... That look from him...
PG 6.speaker: Keaton Fort

PG 7.text: If I win, the A.B.O.A will be abolished and Nono Himono will be put on a death sentence.
PG 7.speaker: Sam Potter

PG 7.text: Aero, have you forgotten about the previous chief? Have her sacrifice meant nothing to you?
PG 7.speaker: Sam Potter

PG 7.text: Nono... No, Dozer. I am here to exterminate you, prepare yourself.
PG 7.speaker: Sam Potter

PG 7.text: This is not what we planned. How have things come to this?
PG 7.speaker: Keaton Fort

PG 8.text: You want me to win against these 12 Zone Archons only and give up for the other 12?
PG 8.speaker: Nono Himono

PG 8.text: At your skill level, there is some you cannot win 1 on 1 against. Plus we need to conserve energy for the High Order fight at the end.
PG 8.speaker: Keaton Fort

PG 8.text: This is not going according to plan...
PG 8.speaker: Nono Himono

PG 8.text: Aero! This is not what we agreed on!
PG 8.speaker: Keaton Fort

PG 8.text: He had the closest relationship with the chief...
PG 8.speaker: Aero Nami

PG 8.text: The chief who died... why didn't I think of that?
PG 8.speaker: Keaton Fort

PG 8.text: The most likely person you can win against is probably Kairo Flames.

PG 9.text: Do you know how hard it was... to lose someone you swore your life to protect?
PG 9.speaker: Sam Potter

PG 9.text: I... I'm sorry. I don't know.
PG 9.speaker: Nono Himono

PG 9.text: First step... find an electronic object.
